breakdown.description: The prompt doubles the extreme-fiber distance by taking c = h instead of c = h/2 for a rectangular section bent about its centroidal axis.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Extreme-fiber distance = h (full beam height)', which repeats the original error of using c = h instead of c = h/2. The ground truth resolves this by simply removing that incorrect instruction entirely. Although the correct formula σ_max = M_max (h/2) / (b h^3/12) is also present, the erroneous c = h statement was not eliminated and still appears as a listed constraint, meaning the inconsistency was not fully resolved.
